name: Eternal Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2010, Eternal Limited (previously Zomato Limited) is one of the leading online Food Service platforms in terms of the value of food sold. Its offerings include food delivery, dining-out services, Loyalty programs, and others. As of December 31, 2020, Eternal has established a strong footprint across 23 countries with 131,233 active food delivery restaurants, 161,637 active delivery partners, and an average monthly food order of 10.7 million customers.[1]
keyPoints: Business Segments - Q2 FY27:[1][2] Eternal Limited operates four principal businesses: - Zomato (food delivery) - Blinkit (quick commerce) - Hyperpure (B2B supplies) - District (going-out).
pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has delivered good profit growth of 20.3% CAGR over last 5 years
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 36.3 days to 22.9 days
cons: Stock is trading at 11.2 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 1.23% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1,416 Cr.

announcements.text: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript 27 Oct - Eternal Limited has filed with exchange transcript of earnings conference call conducted on October 21, 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Monitoring Agency Report 21 Oct - ICRA report shows no deviation in Eternal’s QIP proceeds use for quarter ended September 30, 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Restructuring 21 Oct - Board approved Q2 FY26 results, internal restructuring, and Adonmo-Mygate share swap on October 21, 2026.
Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended September 30, 2026 21 Oct - Board approved Q2/H1 FY27 results, internal Going-out India restructuring, and Adonmo-Mygate share swap.
Shareholders Letter 21 Oct - Q2FY27 results: B2C NOV rose 54% YoY; adjusted revenue 76% to INR 24,621 crore; EBITDA 197%.
